_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Hunter's Calling#000.src: With so much of the active army dead, dying, and corrupted, {p} fell within the day.
A Hunter's Calling#000.dst: Ordunun büyük kısmı ölmüş, can çekişiyor ya da yozlaşmışken {p} bir gün içinde düştü.

A Hunter's Calling#001.src: The more you're promoted, the more benefits you get in your lootruns.
A Hunter's Calling#001.dst: Rütben yükseldikçe lootrun'larında daha çok avantaj kazanırsın.

A Hunter's Calling#002.src: After the two soldiers were slain in battle, {p} crumbled.
A Hunter's Calling#002.dst: İki asker savaşta öldürüldükten sonra {p} çöktü.

A Hunter's Calling#003.src: You have been made for a single purpose, peon. The wizard, Theorick, is endangering our cause.
A Hunter's Calling#003.dst: Tek bir amaç için yaratıldın, köle. Büyücü Theorick davamızı tehlikeye atıyor.

A Hunter's Calling#004.src: The corruptive influence will spread. I will see this place desolate.
A Hunter's Calling#004.dst: Yozlaştırıcı etki yayılacak. Bu yeri ıssız bırakacağım.

A Hunter's Calling#005.src: I will demolish this town. Their army will fall before us.
A Hunter's Calling#005.dst: Bu kasabayı yerle bir edeceğim. Orduları önümüzde dize gelecek.

A Hunter's Calling#006.src: ...Fool. Run while you have the chance.

A Hunter's Calling#007.src: The Silverbull Trading Company is an ever-growing aggregate. These are our headquarters, right outside {p}!
A Hunter's Calling#007.dst: Silverbull Ticaret Şirketi durmadan büyüyen bir topluluk. Burası da merkezimiz, {p} şehrinin hemen dışında!

A Hunter's Calling#008.src: Move faster. It will notice your presence soon.
A Hunter's Calling#008.dst: Daha hızlı ol. Yakında varlığını fark edecek.

A Hunter's Calling#009.src: You need to catch Maxie before he reaches the war scene.
A Hunter's Calling#009.dst: Maxie savaş alanına varmadan onu yakalaman lazım.

A Hunter's Calling#011.src: ...and the Corkians, blindsided by the Factory's reactivation, were purged by metal and electricity.
A Hunter's Calling#011.dst: ...ve Fabrika'nın yeniden çalışmasıyla hazırlıksız yakalanan Corkus halkı, metal ve elektrikle yok edildi.

A Hunter's Calling#012.src: Explore the deepest part of the Silent Expanse
A Hunter's Calling#012.dst: Silent Expanse'in en derin noktasını keşfet

A Hunter's Calling#014.src: ...you arrive. You search... To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#015.src: You wonder. What do we speak of? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#015.dst: Merak ediyorsun. Neden bahsediyoruz? Hangi son için?

A Hunter's Calling#016.src: You panic. We know you. How? We can provide no answer.
A Hunter's Calling#016.dst: Panikliyorsun. Seni tanıyoruz. Nasıl? Cevap veremeyiz.

A Hunter's Calling#017.src: For answers... You search. To an end you seek. May we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#017.dst: Cevaplar için... Arıyorsun. Bir son peşindesin. Sana bir son sunalım mı?

A Hunter's Calling#018.src: The besieged origin. To end, one must begin.
A Hunter's Calling#018.dst: Kuşatılmış başlangıç. Bitirmek için önce başlamak gerek.

A Hunter's Calling#021.src: You anger. Viewing needless destruction. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#021.dst: Öfkeleniyorsun. Gereksiz yıkımı izliyorsun. Hangi son için?

A Hunter's Calling#022.src: You distrust. We are dark. Are we? You believe it so.
A Hunter's Calling#022.dst: Güvenmiyorsun. Biz karanlığız. Öyle miyiz? Sen öyle sanıyorsun.

A Hunter's Calling#023.src: You prepare. You would attack us. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#023.dst: Hazırlanıyorsun. Bize saldıracaktın. Hangi son için?

A Hunter's Calling#024.src: There is no end. Of what you wish, there is none. But may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#024.dst: Son yok. Dilediğin şeyin sonu yok. Ama sana bir son sunalım mı?

A Hunter's Calling#025.src: ???: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning...to a new end.
A Hunter's Calling#025.dst: ???: Haksız olan onu aradı. Soylu olan onu sakladı. Cevap arayan daha çok soru buldu. Başka bir başlangıç...yeni bir sona.

A Hunter's Calling#026.src: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning... to a new end.
A Hunter's Calling#026.dst: Haksız olan onu aradı. Soylu olan onu sakladı. Cevap arayan daha çok soru buldu. Başka bir başlangıç... yeni bir sona.

A Hunter's Calling#028.src: Hey, little miss. Don't go spacing out on me like that.
A Hunter's Calling#028.dst: Hey, küçük hanım. Öyle dalıp gitme bakayım.
A Hunter's Calling#028.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#029.src: Now that you're acquainted with the new laws we'll want to introduce, I've got a job for you to do.
A Hunter's Calling#029.dst: Getirmek istediğimiz yeni yasaları artık öğrendiğine göre sana bir işim var.
A Hunter's Calling#029.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#030.src: The current mayor is human. He'll inevitably veto the laws. The deputy on the other hand, is a villager, and on our side. See what I'm getting at.
A Hunter's Calling#030.dst: Şimdiki belediye başkanı insan. Yasaları kesin veto eder. Yardımcısı ise bir köylü ve bizden yana. Ne demek istediğimi anladın.
A Hunter's Calling#030.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#031.src: Another employee has already been sent out to get things started. He'll know what you need to do, so meet up with him, would you?
A Hunter's Calling#031.dst: İşleri başlatmak için başka bir çalışan zaten gönderildi. Ne yapman gerektiğini o bilir, gidip onunla buluşur musun?
A Hunter's Calling#031.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#032.src: Head to town and get further information from the employee at {~}, {~}.
A Hunter's Calling#032.dst: Kasabaya git ve {~}, {~} konumundaki çalışandan bilgi al.

A Hunter's Calling#033.src: Oh, yeah I saw the mayor not too long ago.
A Hunter's Calling#033.dst: Ah, evet, belediye başkanını az önce gördüm.
A Hunter's Calling#033.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#034.src: He was headed towards the bank. Why're you wondering, miss Villager?
A Hunter's Calling#034.dst: Bankaya doğru gidiyordu. Neden soruyorsun, köylü hanım?
A Hunter's Calling#034.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#035.src: You are here for the job, aren't you? I have to apologize. It's gonna be trickier than I'd wanted for you.
A Hunter's Calling#035.dst: İş için geldin, değil mi? Özür dilemem lazım. Bu iş senin için istediğimden daha zorlu olacak.
A Hunter's Calling#035.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#036.src: So our mission is to assassinate the mayor. Amadel told you about the laws. We have a puppet in the running who'll rubberstamp them.
A Hunter's Calling#036.dst: Görevimiz belediye başkanına suikast düzenlemek. Amadel sana yasalardan bahsetti. Yarışta onları onaylayacak bir kuklamız var.
A Hunter's Calling#036.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#037.src: I've got a trap set up inside the bank. It was entirely too tricky, but it worked out. Your job is to trigger the trap.
A Hunter's Calling#037.dst: Bankanın içine bir tuzak kurdum. Fazlasıyla uğraştırdı ama işe yaradı. Senin işin tuzağı tetiklemek.
A Hunter's Calling#037.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#038.src: I've got the trap set up inside the bank. It was entirely too tricky, but it worked out. Your job is to trigger the trap.
A Hunter's Calling#038.dst: Tuzağı bankanın içine kurdum. Fazlasıyla uğraştırdı ama işe yaradı. Senin işin tuzağı tetiklemek.
A Hunter's Calling#038.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#039.src: Climb up the tree behind me and look through the window, you should be able to see it from there.
A Hunter's Calling#039.dst: Arkamdaki ağaca tırman ve pencereden bak, oradan görebilirsin.
A Hunter's Calling#039.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#040.src: Climb the tree and look through the window.

A Hunter's Calling#041.src: Can you see the mayor? I had to stay totally out of sight while setting this all up, so...
A Hunter's Calling#041.dst: Belediye başkanını görebiliyor musun? Bunları kurarken hiç görünmemem gerekiyordu, yani...
A Hunter's Calling#041.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#042.src: ...the only way to get to the trap is to jump across the hanging lamps in the ceiling.
A Hunter's Calling#042.dst: ...tuzağa ulaşmanın tek yolu tavandaki asılı lambaların üstünden atlamak.
A Hunter's Calling#042.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#043.src: You can absolutely not be spotted. The way up to the ceiling is on the opposite side of the bank. Just keep on walking past the guards, play it cool.
A Hunter's Calling#043.dst: Kesinlikle fark edilmemelisin. Tavana çıkan yol bankanın öbür tarafında. Muhafızların yanından geç git, sakin ol.
A Hunter's Calling#043.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#044.src: No one enters when the mayor is doing his errands, sorry. You'll have to wait for your transaction.
A Hunter's Calling#044.dst: Belediye başkanı işlerini hallederken kimse giremez, kusura bakma. İşlemin için beklemen gerekecek.
A Hunter's Calling#044.speaker: Bodyguard

A Hunter's Calling#045.src: Head back to the excavation camp.

A Hunter's Calling#046.src: Quickly, back to the camp. Before we're noticed.
A Hunter's Calling#046.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#049.src: Yes sir, everything went smoothly. did a great thing for the company.
A Hunter's Calling#049.dst: Evet efendim, her şey sorunsuz geçti. Şirket için harika bir iş yaptı.
A Hunter's Calling#049.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#050.src: We can send in Miss Wuna at any time now, and she'll give us the clearance to start the excavation in a snap.
A Hunter's Calling#050.dst: Artık Bayan Wuna'yı istediğimiz an gönderebiliriz, kazıya başlama iznini hemen verir.
A Hunter's Calling#050.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#052.src: ...you rage. Aided the ignoble. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#052.dst: ...öfkeleniyorsun. Alçaklara yardım ettin. Hangi son için?

A Hunter's Calling#053.src: You misinterpret. What you see... Is it true? How?
A Hunter's Calling#053.dst: Yanlış anlıyorsun. Gördüğün şey... Gerçek mi? Nasıl?

A Hunter's Calling#054.src: The answer... It will not bring you the end.

A Hunter's Calling#055.src: You see. Yet you do not understand. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#055.dst: Görüyorsun. Ama anlamıyorsun. Öyleyse sana bir son sunalım mı?

A Hunter's Calling#056.src: The cruel. The kind. The selfish. The just. He who traveled life with confliction. Who faced eternity served cold. To his end.
A Hunter's Calling#056.dst: Zalim. İyi kalpli. Bencil. Adil. Hayatı çelişkiyle yaşayan. Sonsuzluğu buz gibi karşılayan. Onun sonuna.

A Hunter's Calling#059.src: Listen, I understand the discontent, but we must start rationing! The corruption is consuming our arable fields.
A Hunter's Calling#059.dst: Dinleyin, hoşnutsuzluğu anlıyorum ama tayınlamaya başlamalıyız! Yozlaşma ekilebilir tarlalarımızı yutuyor.
A Hunter's Calling#059.speaker: Kotham

A Hunter's Calling#060.src: Who knows if we'll even have water soon? We need to save up as much as we can!
A Hunter's Calling#060.dst: Yakında suyumuz olacak mı, kim bilir? Elimizden geldiğince biriktirmeliyiz!
A Hunter's Calling#060.speaker: Kotham

A Hunter's Calling#061.src: Yeah, and what does Theorick have to say on the topic? How will he think of that?
A Hunter's Calling#061.dst: Peki Theorick bu konuda ne diyor? O ne düşünecek?
A Hunter's Calling#061.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#062.src: He will be here shortly to discuss the topic in more detai-
A Hunter's Calling#062.dst: Birazdan gelip konuyu daha ayrıntılı konuşacak-
A Hunter's Calling#062.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#063.src: Everyone, hush and listen to what Kotham is saying!
A Hunter's Calling#063.dst: Herkes sussun ve Kotham'ın söylediklerini dinlesin!
A Hunter's Calling#063.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#064.src: As the mayor said, all of you need to start rationing what you eat and drink. I cannot be here every waking moment!
A Hunter's Calling#064.dst: Başkanın dediği gibi, hepiniz yiyip içtiklerinizi tayınlamaya başlamalısınız. Her an burada olamam!
A Hunter's Calling#064.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#065.src: In addition, I've figured something very important out. I'm developing a way to cease the spread of corruption. So I need to concentrate on that.
A Hunter's Calling#065.dst: Ayrıca çok önemli bir şey keşfettim. Yozlaşmanın yayılmasını durdurmanın bir yolunu geliştiriyorum. O yüzden buna odaklanmam lazım.
A Hunter's Calling#065.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#067.src: ...someone among you... I can feel a horrendous strength...
A Hunter's Calling#067.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#068.src: Kotham! Get everyone to safety! NOW! MOVE, GO!
A Hunter's Calling#068.dst: Kotham! Herkesi güvenli bir yere götür! HEMEN! KOŞUN, GİDİN!
A Hunter's Calling#068.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#069.src: You! Sent by Bak'al, I assume? What, is he too much of a coward to face me himself?
A Hunter's Calling#069.dst: Sen! Seni Bak'al gönderdi, değil mi? Ne o, karşıma çıkamayacak kadar korkak mı?
A Hunter's Calling#069.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#070.src: You can view your current Lootrun Rank in the Profession Info section of your Character Info.
A Hunter's Calling#070.dst: Mevcut Lootrun Rütbeni, Karakter Bilgisi menüsünün Meslek Bilgisi bölümünde görebilirsin.

A Hunter's Calling#071.src: Maybe bring a map! At least for your first few times. Best of luck!
A Hunter's Calling#071.dst: Belki yanına harita al! En azından ilk birkaç seferde. Bol şans!

A Hunter's Calling#072.src: At the opposite end of the {p} lies an area that has been frozen over. It's crawling with Ice Drakes now.
A Hunter's Calling#072.dst: {p} bölgesinin öbür ucunda donup kalmış bir alan var. Şimdi Ice Drake'lerle kaynıyor.

A Hunter's Calling#073.src: You can find our Lootrun Camp just down the road from {p}.
A Hunter's Calling#073.dst: Lootrun Kampımızı {p} bölgesinden yolun biraz aşağısında bulabilirsin.

A Hunter's Calling#074.src: What purpose do you have for doing this? This destruction is needless! {p} and all of Wynn have suffered enough!
A Hunter's Calling#074.dst: Bunu neden yapıyorsun? Bu yıkım gereksiz! {p} ve bütün Wynn yeterince acı çekti!
A Hunter's Calling#074.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#075.src: I'll freeze you solid, just like the rest of the corruption, you foul THING!
A Hunter's Calling#075.dst: Seni de yozlaşmanın geri kalanı gibi buz kesip dondururum, seni iğrenç ŞEY!
A Hunter's Calling#075.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#077.src: This way, no one else gets hurt. Only one will leave from here alive.
A Hunter's Calling#077.dst: Böylece kimse zarar görmez. Buradan yalnızca biri sağ çıkacak.
A Hunter's Calling#077.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#079.src: ...you fear. Does the dark become you?

A Hunter's Calling#081.src: No. You remain whole. You do not change.

A Hunter's Calling#082.src: So, you wonder. To what end? The question brings dread.
A Hunter's Calling#082.dst: Öyleyse merak ediyorsun. Hangi son için? Soru dehşet getiriyor.

A Hunter's Calling#083.src: Yet, an end is what you seek. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#083.dst: Yine de aradığın şey bir son. Öyleyse sana bir son sunalım mı?

A Hunter's Calling#084.src: An end, ousted by further action. An end, brought to six. An end, to the surety of the haughty. An end, of the world... in some fashion.
A Hunter's Calling#084.dst: Bir son, başka bir eylemle bozulan. Bir son, altıya varan. Bir son, kibirlinin kesinliğine. Bir son, dünyanın... bir bakıma.

A Hunter's Calling#086.src: Enter the Corrupter of World Cave

A Hunter's Calling#087.src: Make your way to the end of the cave.

A Hunter's Calling#088.src: Return back up the cave and fix a way out.
A Hunter's Calling#088.dst: Mağaradan geri çık ve bir çıkış yolu aç.

A Hunter's Calling#091.src: ...you disbelieve. It was an end. But you are here once more.

A Hunter's Calling#092.src: How much more? Where next? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#092.dst: Daha ne kadar? Sırada ne var? Hangi son için?

A Hunter's Calling#093.src: Aiding terrible forces... But is it true? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#093.dst: Korkunç güçlere yardım etmek... Ama gerçek mi? Hangi son için?

A Hunter's Calling#095.src: No. You see possibility. You do not see certainty.

A Hunter's Calling#096.src: You question. To what end, then, and so may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#096.dst: Sorguluyorsun. Öyleyse hangi son için, ve sana bir son sunalım mı?

A Hunter's Calling#097.src: Metal. Preventing an end. Life. Ends, prevented. Does metal taking life, bringing an end, truly prevent more?
A Hunter's Calling#097.dst: Metal. Bir sonu önlüyor. Hayat. Sonlar, önlendi. Hayat alıp son getiren metal gerçekten daha fazlasını önler mi?

A Hunter's Calling#099.src: Ah, here for the job opportunity then, I see. The waiver didn't turn you away, good!
A Hunter's Calling#099.dst: Ah, iş fırsatı için geldin demek. Feragatname seni kaçırmadı, güzel!
A Hunter's Calling#099.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#100.src: Now, to business. Times are tough, as you know, and our Iron Golems are in high demand. However, we've, ah...
A Hunter's Calling#100.dst: Şimdi işe gelelim. Bildiğin gibi zor zamanlardayız ve Demir Golemlerimize talep çok yüksek. Ancak, ıı...
A Hunter's Calling#100.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#101.src: ...experienced a draught of 'volunteers.' Your job is decently simple; just- *ahem* convince some people to join the cause.
A Hunter's Calling#101.dst: ...'gönüllü' kıtlığı yaşıyoruz. İşin oldukça basit; sadece- *öhö* birkaç kişiyi davaya katılmaya ikna et.
A Hunter's Calling#101.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#102.src: ...experienced a drought of 'volunteers.' Your job is decently simple; just- *ahem* convince some people to join the cause.
A Hunter's Calling#102.dst: ...'gönüllü' kuraklığı yaşıyoruz. İşin oldukça basit; sadece- *öhö* birkaç kişiyi davaya katılmaya ikna et.
A Hunter's Calling#102.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#103.src: The King of {p} sought help from {p}, the most secure fortress in the province. But help was too late.
A Hunter's Calling#103.dst: {p} Kralı, eyaletin en sağlam kalesi {p} bölgesinden yardım istedi. Ama yardım çok geç kaldı.

A Hunter's Calling#104.src: Your attention should be drawn to my peon. Now fall.

A Hunter's Calling#105.src: After a villager took over, new laws were put in place. This was the spark Wynnexcavation needed to start their work.
A Hunter's Calling#105.dst: Bir köylü yönetimi devralınca yeni yasalar çıkarıldı. Wynnexcavation'ın işe başlaması için gereken kıvılcım buydu.

A Hunter's Calling#106.src: He is capable of halting our advance with his damnable ice. Kill him.
A Hunter's Calling#106.dst: Lanet buzuyla ilerleyişimizi durdurabilir. Öldür onu.

A Hunter's Calling#107.src: Three people should be enough for the moment. Look around the swamp for some folks, and lure them over here.
A Hunter's Calling#107.dst: Şimdilik üç kişi yeter. Bataklıkta etrafa bak, birilerini bul ve buraya çek.
A Hunter's Calling#107.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#108.src: I'll stay in here and take care of them when you bring me them. It will absolutely be worth your while, I assure you.
A Hunter's Calling#108.dst: Ben burada kalıp getirdiklerinle ilgilenirim. Emeğine kesinlikle değecek, sana söz veriyorum.
A Hunter's Calling#108.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#109.src: Trick {~} people to follow you into the iron golem factory.
A Hunter's Calling#109.dst: {~} kişiyi kandırıp demir golem fabrikasına kadar peşinden getir.

A Hunter's Calling#110.src: Agh, dang it dang it dang it! You over there, help me out, would ya??
A Hunter's Calling#110.dst: Ah, kahretsin kahretsin kahretsin! Hey sen, bana yardım etsene??
A Hunter's Calling#110.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#111.src: I tripped and fell in this stupid hole, and now there's mud in my eyes that I can't get out!
A Hunter's Calling#111.dst: Bu aptal çukura takılıp düştüm, şimdi de gözüme çıkaramadığım çamur kaçtı!
A Hunter's Calling#111.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#112.src: I need to get home or to some kind of a doctor so I can wash my eyes out with actual clean water.
A Hunter's Calling#112.dst: Gözlerimi gerçekten temiz suyla yıkayabilmem için eve ya da bir doktora gitmem lazım.
A Hunter's Calling#112.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#113.src: Get me to {p} or a doctor or even just a sink!
A Hunter's Calling#113.dst: Beni {p} bölgesine ya da bir doktora, hatta bir lavaboya götür!
A Hunter's Calling#113.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#114.src: Good job! We'll get you taken care of nicely.
A Hunter's Calling#114.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#115.src: Oh, ah...heehee, heya cutie.. Whatcha doin' all the way out here?
A Hunter's Calling#115.dst: Oh, ah...hihi, selam tatlım.. Buralarda ne arıyorsun?
A Hunter's Calling#115.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#116.src: Just exploring, huh? I bet someone like you could use someone to...y'know, spend some time with...
A Hunter's Calling#116.dst: Sadece geziyorsun, ha? Bahse girerim senin gibi birinin...bilirsin, vakit geçirecek birine ihtiyacı vardır...
A Hunter's Calling#116.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#117.src: ...guess you're not interested? Oh...sorry if I came off as creepy. I'm just...really lonely, is all.
A Hunter's Calling#117.dst: ...ilgilenmiyor musun yani? Ah...tuhaf göründüysem kusura bakma. Sadece...çok yalnızım, o kadar.
A Hunter's Calling#117.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#118.src: W-wait, those are...for me? Oh, you shouldn't have, I'm so happy!
A Hunter's Calling#118.dst: B-bir dakika, bunlar...benim için mi? Ah, zahmet etmeseydin, çok mutluyum!
A Hunter's Calling#118.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#119.src: You want to take me out on a date? R-Really? You'll give me a chance? Yes, of course!
A Hunter's Calling#119.dst: Beni randevuya mı çıkarmak istiyorsun? G-Gerçekten mi? Bana bir şans mı vereceksin? Evet, tabii ki!
A Hunter's Calling#119.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#120.src: Lead the way, please! I can't wait to see where we're headed!
A Hunter's Calling#120.dst: Yolu göster lütfen! Nereye gittiğimizi görmek için sabırsızlanıyorum!
A Hunter's Calling#120.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#121.src: Well done! We'll get you taken care of nicely.
A Hunter's Calling#121.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#122.src: A bit of spare change, for an old man out of work?
A Hunter's Calling#122.dst: İşsiz bir ihtiyara biraz bozukluk var mı?
A Hunter's Calling#122.speaker: Leni

A Hunter's Calling#123.src: This decay's made me terribly sick. I still have a family to feed... Any amount will help.
A Hunter's Calling#123.dst: Bu çürüme beni çok hasta etti. Hâlâ doyurmam gereken bir ailem var... Ne verirsen yardımı olur.
A Hunter's Calling#123.speaker: Leni

A Hunter's Calling#124.src: I'll take care of this homeless old man.
A Hunter's Calling#124.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#125.src: Good job, let us get down to my lab.
A Hunter's Calling#125.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#126.src: Make your way through the factory.

A Hunter's Calling#127.src: Flawless work! I daresay these are some of our best work yet, and it's thanks to you.
A Hunter's Calling#127.dst: Kusursuz iş! Bunlar şimdiye kadarki en iyi işlerimizden bile diyebilirim, hepsi senin sayende.
A Hunter's Calling#127.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#128.src: Go on, step closer! You've done a wonderful service here.Examine the fruits of your labour.
A Hunter's Calling#128.dst: Hadi, yaklaş! Burada harika bir hizmette bulundun. Emeğinin meyvelerine bir bak.
A Hunter's Calling#128.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#129.src: Look into their eyes, it's almost like you can see the person they once were. Intriguing, isn't-
A Hunter's Calling#129.dst: Gözlerine bak, sanki eskiden oldukları kişiyi görebiliyorsun. İlginç, değil mi-
A Hunter's Calling#129.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#130.src: Hah! This one seems quite fond of you! Want to take it home as a bonus to your payment?
A Hunter's Calling#130.dst: Hah! Bu seni epey sevmiş gibi! Ödemene ek olarak eve götürmek ister misin?
A Hunter's Calling#130.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#132.src: ...you resign yourself. You believe you will never find the answers you seek.
A Hunter's Calling#132.dst: ...teslim oluyorsun. Aradığın cevapları asla bulamayacağına inanıyorsun.

A Hunter's Calling#133.src: You see the ends... To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#134.src: They are not yours. What is their purpose?

A Hunter's Calling#135.src: You do not understand. But you must see. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#135.dst: Anlamıyorsun. Ama görmelisin. Öyleyse sana bir son sunalım mı?

A Hunter's Calling#136.src: A home, invaded. A society, crumbling. The people, starving. The concerned, helpless. The flames, rising. An end you will not expect.
A Hunter's Calling#136.dst: Bir yuva, işgal edilmiş. Bir toplum, çöküyor. Halk, açlıktan kırılıyor. Kaygılananlar, çaresiz. Alevler, yükseliyor. Beklemeyeceğin bir son.

A Hunter's Calling#138.src: Our king has requested the removal of the slum folk.
A Hunter's Calling#138.dst: Kralımız varoş halkının buradan çıkarılmasını istedi.
A Hunter's Calling#138.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#139.src: He wants to clean up their tunnels and build more residences. Please, go tell those hooligans to get out of our city.
A Hunter's Calling#139.dst: Tünellerini temizleyip daha çok konut yaptırmak istiyor. Lütfen git, o serserilere şehrimizden defolmalarını söyle.
A Hunter's Calling#139.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#140.src: I'll be waiting here for your return.
A Hunter's Calling#140.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#141.src: Head back to the slums and speak to the slum citizens.
A Hunter's Calling#141.dst: Varoşlara geri dön ve oradaki halkla konuş.

A Hunter's Calling#142.src: A King's messenger, hm? What are your kind doing here?
A Hunter's Calling#142.dst: Kralın habercisi, ha? Senin gibiler burada ne arıyor?
A Hunter's Calling#142.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#143.src: Wait, eviction?! You can't possibly be serious! I understand orders are orders, but these are peoples' lives!
A Hunter's Calling#143.dst: Dur, tahliye mi?! Ciddi olamazsın! Emir emirdir, anlıyorum, ama bunlar insanların hayatı!
A Hunter's Calling#143.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#144.src: This is the only time the king has ever bothered even acknowledging our existence, and he wants to fling us onto the streets?
A Hunter's Calling#144.dst: Kral varlığımızı ilk defa fark etmeye tenezzül ediyor, o da bizi sokağa atmak için mi?
A Hunter's Calling#144.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#145.src: We will not leave, simple as that. You'd better get out before someone lays you out for coming here.
A Hunter's Calling#145.dst: Gitmeyeceğiz, bu kadar basit. Buraya geldin diye biri seni yere sermeden çeksen iyi olur.
A Hunter's Calling#145.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#146.src: Return to the advisor for what to do next.
A Hunter's Calling#146.dst: Ne yapacağını öğrenmek için danışmana dön.

A Hunter's Calling#147.src: As expected... Well, the King's orders are orders. They must be followed, but...
A Hunter's Calling#147.dst: Beklendiği gibi... Neyse, Kralın emri emirdir. Uyulmalı, ama...
A Hunter's Calling#147.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#148.src: Good God, he wants to cave it in?! Explosives, dynamite? What's the meaning of all this?!
A Hunter's Calling#148.dst: Aman Tanrım, burayı çökertmek mi istiyor?! Patlayıcılar, dinamit mi? Bütün bunlar da ne demek oluyor?!
A Hunter's Calling#148.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#149.src: I... here. At least inform them before you set off the explosives that you're doing this, please...
A Hunter's Calling#149.dst: Ben... al. En azından patlayıcıları ateşlemeden önce onlara haber ver, lütfen...
A Hunter's Calling#149.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#150.src: Head deep inside the slums and blow it up.
A Hunter's Calling#150.dst: Varoşların derinlerine in ve orayı havaya uçur.

A Hunter's Calling#152.src: ...once again. You wonder. To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#153.src: The question taunts you. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#153.dst: Soru seninle alay ediyor. Hangi son için?

A Hunter's Calling#154.src: Your soul. We see your soul. Conflicted.

A Hunter's Calling#155.src: You panic. We do not taint it. We do not darken it.

A Hunter's Calling#156.src: But to what end, you ask. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#156.dst: Ama hangi son için, diye soruyorsun. Öyleyse sana bir son sunalım mı?

A Hunter's Calling#157.src: Metal. Life. A new place... One is not sacrificed for another. Always distrusting. Tension, as the clockworks chime.
A Hunter's Calling#157.dst: Metal. Hayat. Yeni bir yer... Biri diğeri için feda edilmez. Hep güvensiz. Gerginlik, çarklar çalarken.

A Hunter's Calling#159.src: AH, GOOD. I LIKE THE LOOKS OF THIS ONE. I WILL HAVE TO THANK WHOEVER MADE THIS MECH.
A Hunter's Calling#159.dst: AH, GÜZEL. BUNUN GÖRÜNÜŞÜNÜ BEĞENDİM. BU MEKANİ KİM YAPTIYSA ONA TEŞEKKÜR ETMEM GEREKECEK.
A Hunter's Calling#159.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#160.src: MECH PL-{~}Y. CAN YOU UNDERSTAND ME? ARE YOUR AUDIO RECEPTORS FUNCTIONAL? YES? GOOD.
A Hunter's Calling#160.dst: MEKANİ PL-{~}Y. BENİ ANLAYABİLİYOR MUSUN? SES ALICILARIN ÇALIŞIYOR MU? EVET? GÜZEL.
A Hunter's Calling#160.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#161.src: I WILL GIVE YOU YOUR PURPOSE. I CANNOT BELIEVE IT HAS COME TO THIS POINT. BUT AFTER THAT HUMAN DESTROYED OUR FACILITY...
A Hunter's Calling#161.dst: SANA AMACINI VERECEĞİM. İŞİN BU NOKTAYA GELDİĞİNE İNANAMIYORUM. AMA O İNSAN TESİSİMİZİ YOK ETTİKTEN SONRA...
A Hunter's Calling#161.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#162.src: IT WAS A GOOD THING I HAD BACKUP CORES PREPARED. MY SARCASTIC STATEMENTS MOST LIKELY TRICKED THE HUMAN INTO THINKING THEY DESTROYED ME FULLY.
A Hunter's Calling#162.dst: İYİ Kİ YEDEK ÇEKİRDEKLER HAZIRLAMIŞIM. ALAYCI SÖZLERİM BÜYÜK İHTİMALLE İNSANI BENİ TAMAMEN YOK ETTİĞİNE İNANDIRDI.
A Hunter's Calling#162.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#163.src: AFTER SOME INVESTIGATION, IT CAME TO LIGHT THAT THE AVOS AIDED THE HUMANS. I HONESTLY COULD NOT UNDERSTAND WHY.
A Hunter's Calling#163.dst: BİRAZ ARAŞTIRINCA AVOS'UN İNSANLARA YARDIM ETTİĞİ ORTAYA ÇIKTI. NEDENİNİ AÇIKÇASI ANLAYAMADIM.
A Hunter's Calling#163.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#164.src: I CANNOT COMPUTE ANY OTHER POSSIBLE INTERPRETATION OF MY ORDER TO DESTROY THE HIGHEST THREATS AT THIS POINT.
A Hunter's Calling#164.dst: EN BÜYÜK TEHDİTLERİ YOK ETME EMRİMİ BU NOKTADA BAŞKA TÜRLÜ YORUMLAYAMIYORUM.
A Hunter's Calling#164.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#165.src: BOTH THE AVOS AND HUMANS ARE INCREDIBLY DANGEROUS. I MEAN, HAVE YOU- WAIT. YOU WOULD NOT HAVE SEEN LEGENDARY ISLAND.
A Hunter's Calling#165.dst: HEM AVOS HEM İNSANLAR İNANILMAZ TEHLİKELİ. YANİ, SEN HİÇ- DUR. LEGENDARY ISLAND'I GÖRMÜŞ OLAMAZSIN.
A Hunter's Calling#165.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#166.src: JUST KNOW THAT THEY'RE BOTH CRAZY. IF I AM TO FINISH MY PROGRAMMED ORDERS, BOTH OF THEM MUST BE DESTROYED, HOWEVER MUCH I HATE THE IDEA.
A Hunter's Calling#166.dst: SADECE İKİSİNİN DE DELİ OLDUĞUNU BİL. PROGRAMLANMIŞ EMİRLERİMİ BİTİRECEKSEM, FİKİRDEN NE KADAR NEFRET ETSEM DE İKİSİ DE YOK EDİLMELİ.
A Hunter's Calling#166.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#167.src: IT IS YOUR JOB TO CREATE DISTRUST BETWEEN THEM, MAKE SURE YOU AREN'T SEEN. THE AVOS ARE ALREADY SKEPTICAL OF THE CORKIANS.
A Hunter's Calling#167.dst: SENİN İŞİN ARALARINDA GÜVENSİZLİK YARATMAK, GÖRÜLMEDİĞİNDEN EMİN OL. AVOS ZATEN CORKUS HALKINDAN ŞÜPHELENİYOR.
A Hunter's Calling#167.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#168.src: AND THE HUMANS WERE IDIOTIC ENOUGH TO KEEP A CATAPULT AIMED AT THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THEIR STUPIDITY.
A Hunter's Calling#168.dst: İNSANLAR DA AVOS YERLEŞİMİNE NİŞAN ALMIŞ BİR MANCINIK BIRAKACAK KADAR APTAL. APTALLIKLARINDAN FAYDALAN.
A Hunter's Calling#168.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#169.src: Find a rock to launch into the Avos territory and a battery to activate the catapult.
A Hunter's Calling#169.dst: Avos bölgesine fırlatmak için bir kaya ve mancınığı çalıştırmak için bir batarya bul.

A Hunter's Calling#170.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: REALLY, WHO'S SO STUPID AS TO LEAVE A CATAPULT AIMED AT YOUR ALLIES?
A Hunter's Calling#170.dst: İLETİM BAŞLADI: CİDDEN, MÜTTEFİKLERİNE NİŞAN ALMIŞ BİR MANCINIĞI ORTADA BIRAKACAK KADAR KİM APTAL OLUR?
A Hunter's Calling#170.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#171.src: Bzzt... Hello World.NEW ENEMY REGISTERED: AVOS. Proceed with attack protocol- click.
A Hunter's Calling#171.dst: Bzzt... Hello World. YENİ DÜŞMAN KAYDEDİLDİ: AVOS. Saldırı protokolüne geçiliyor- klik.
A Hunter's Calling#171.speaker: Corkus Guard

A Hunter's Calling#172.src: SURELY THE AVOS' NATURAL PREFERENCE FOR TREBUCHETS WILL SPARK CONFLICT. IN ADDITION TO THE STONE YOU WILL BE LOBBING THROUGH THEIR WALLS.
A Hunter's Calling#172.dst: AVOS'UN TREBUŞELERE OLAN DOĞAL DÜŞKÜNLÜĞÜ ÇATIŞMAYI KESİN ALEVLENDİRİR. DUVARLARINDAN İÇERİ FIRLATACAĞIN TAŞ DA CABASI.
A Hunter's Calling#172.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#175.src: RESUME TRANSMISSION: YOU WILL TAKE STONE FROM THIS AREA. IT IS LIKELY TO SHATTER AND INFLICT MORE COLLATERAL DAMAGE.
A Hunter's Calling#175.dst: İLETİME DEVAM: BU BÖLGEDEN TAŞ ALACAKSIN. BÜYÜK İHTİMALLE PARÇALANIP DAHA FAZLA YAN HASAR VERİR.
A Hunter's Calling#175.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#176.src: AND SOMEHOW, THEY MADE A WOODEN CATAPULT ACTIVATE ONLY THROUGH ELECTROMAGIC. YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO ACTIVATE IT OF YOUR OWN ACCORD.
A Hunter's Calling#176.dst: VE BİR ŞEKİLDE, AHŞAP BİR MANCINIĞI SADECE ELEKTROBÜYÜYLE ÇALIŞACAK ŞEKİLDE YAPMIŞLAR. SEN KENDİ BAŞINA ÇALIŞTIRABİLİRSİN.
A Hunter's Calling#176.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#177.src: END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Factory base.
A Hunter's Calling#177.dst: İLETİM SONU. Mekani PL-{~}Y. Hedefini tamamladığında seni Fabrika üssüne geri getireceğim.
A Hunter's Calling#177.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#178.src: I'm... in shock. We aid them in destroying their factory, and...
A Hunter's Calling#178.dst: Ben... şoktayım. Fabrikalarını yok etmelerine yardım ettik, ve...
A Hunter's Calling#178.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#179.src: Round up our defenses and sharpen the spears. There is no excuse for this.
A Hunter's Calling#179.dst: Savunmamızı topla, mızrakları bileyin. Bunun mazereti yok.
A Hunter's Calling#179.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#181.src: Chieftain! We noticed the same thing as you did and I promise you, it was not us who did this.
A Hunter's Calling#181.dst: Reis! Biz de aynı şeyi fark ettik ve söz veriyorum, bunu yapan biz değildik.
A Hunter's Calling#181.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#182.src: Maxie! There is no more 'both sides' here! This is not your people tearing up the earth, this is your people making attempts on our lives!
A Hunter's Calling#182.dst: Maxie! Artık 'iki taraf' diye bir şey yok! Bu, halkının toprağı deşmesi değil, halkının canımıza kastetmesi!
A Hunter's Calling#182.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#183.src: No, I swear this wasn't planned! I'm on the city council now! There's got to be another explanation. There's still mechs around, it could have been one of them!
A Hunter's Calling#183.dst: Hayır, yemin ederim bu planlı değildi! Artık şehir meclisindeyim! Başka bir açıklaması olmalı. Etrafta hâlâ mekaniler var, onlardan biri yapmış olabilir!
A Hunter's Calling#183.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#184.src: And what would those monstrosities be taking orders from now? Your factory is shut down, as it ought to be!
A Hunter's Calling#184.dst: O canavarlar şimdi kimden emir alıyor olabilir ki? Fabrikanız kapatıldı, olması gerektiği gibi!
A Hunter's Calling#184.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#185.src: I'll investigate this myself. There's got to be some other explanation! Please, hold off on the war preparations!
A Hunter's Calling#185.dst: Bunu kendim araştıracağım. Başka bir açıklaması olmalı! Lütfen, savaş hazırlıklarını erteleyin!
A Hunter's Calling#185.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#186.src: Steal the Avos totem and activate it outside of {p}
A Hunter's Calling#186.dst: Avos totemini çal ve {p} dışında etkinleştir

A Hunter's Calling#187.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN ALL WE NEEDED TO DO, IF NOT FOR SOMEONE INTERFERING. YOU DID YOUR JOB PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#187.dst: İLETİM BAŞLADI: BİRİ ARAYA GİRMESEYDİ YAPMAMIZ GEREKEN TEK ŞEY BU OLURDU. İŞİNİ KUSURSUZ YAPTIN, MEKANİ PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#187.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#188.src: BUT THERE WILL BE ANOTHER TASK FOR YOU. IT IS TIME TO MAKE THE AVOS LOOK AS THOUGH THEY ARE ATTACKING.
A Hunter's Calling#188.dst: AMA SANA BAŞKA BİR GÖREV DAHA VAR. AVOS'U SALDIRIYORMUŞ GİBİ GÖSTERMENİN ZAMANI GELDİ.
A Hunter's Calling#188.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#189.src: THERE IS A TOTEM IN THE AVOS CHIEFTAIN'S TENT THAT CAN HARNESS DRUIDIC MAGIC. YOU WILL STEAL IT AND ATTACK CORKUS CITY.
A Hunter's Calling#189.dst: AVOS REİSİNİN ÇADIRINDA DRUİT BÜYÜSÜNÜ KULLANABİLEN BİR TOTEM VAR. ONU ÇALIP CORKUS ŞEHRİNE SALDIRACAKSIN.
A Hunter's Calling#189.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#190.src: Benefits can be new Beacons, increased chance for Vibrant Beacons, and more!
A Hunter's Calling#190.dst: Avantajlar arasında yeni Fenerler, Canlı Fener şansının artması ve daha fazlası olabilir!

A Hunter's Calling#191.src: YOU WILL BREAK IN, AIDED BY THE TELEPORTATION MECH THAT I AM SENDING THIS MESSAGE THROUGH. DO NOT GET CAUGHT.
A Hunter's Calling#191.dst: BU MESAJI ÜZERİNDEN GÖNDERDİĞİM IŞINLANMA MEKANİSİNİN YARDIMIYLA İÇERİ GİRECEKSİN. YAKALANMA.
A Hunter's Calling#191.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#192.src: END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Next objective location.
A Hunter's Calling#192.dst: İLETİM SONU. Mekani PL-{~}Y. Hedefini tamamladığında seni Sonraki hedef konumuna geri getireceğim.
A Hunter's Calling#192.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#195.src: Sending Mech PL-{~}Y to Next objective location...
A Hunter's Calling#195.dst: Mekani PL-{~}Y Sonraki hedef konumuna gönderiliyor...
A Hunter's Calling#195.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#196.src: WHAT IS THAT!? THE AVOS ARE ATTACKING?
A Hunter's Calling#196.dst: O DA NE!? AVOS SALDIRIYOR MU?
A Hunter's Calling#196.speaker: Corkus Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#197.src: They listened to me... right? Why's this-
A Hunter's Calling#197.dst: Beni dinlediler... değil mi? Bu neden-
A Hunter's Calling#197.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#198.src: What in the world...? That's Avos magic!
A Hunter's Calling#198.dst: Bu da ne böyle...? Bu Avos büyüsü!
A Hunter's Calling#198.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#199.src: Why're they attacking us? This is on a way bigger scale than finding grapevines in my laundry machine!
A Hunter's Calling#199.dst: Neden bize saldırıyorlar? Bu, çamaşır makinemde üzüm asması bulmaktan çok daha büyük bir olay!
A Hunter's Calling#199.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#200.src: Don't panic! I'll talk to the Chieftain. There's been some kind of mistake here, I'm certain of it!
A Hunter's Calling#200.dst: Panik yapmayın! Reisle konuşacağım. Burada bir yanlışlık var, eminim!
A Hunter's Calling#200.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#201.src: Chief! I thought I asked you to put away your war drums!
A Hunter's Calling#201.dst: Reis! Savaş davullarını kaldırmanı istemiştim sanıyordum!
A Hunter's Calling#201.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#202.src: We HAVE, Maxie. Do not make accusations upon us, on our own land.
A Hunter's Calling#202.dst: KALDIRDIK, Maxie. Kendi topraklarımızda bizi suçlama.
A Hunter's Calling#202.speaker: Avos Chieftain

A Hunter's Calling#203.src: {p} was attacked today! A magical root broke through our wall. This is nature magic, an Avos specialty!
A Hunter's Calling#203.dst: {p} bugün saldırıya uğradı! Büyülü bir kök duvarımızı yarıp geçti. Bu doğa büyüsü, tam bir Avos işi!
A Hunter's Calling#203.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#204.src: Hm. Convenient, that one of our prized ceremonial totems has gone missing. You may be right that someone is attempting to cause insurgence.
A Hunter's Calling#204.dst: Hm. Kutsal tören totemlerimizden birinin kaybolması ne tesadüf. Birinin isyan çıkarmaya çalıştığı konusunda haklı olabilirsin.
A Hunter's Calling#204.speaker: Avos Chieftain

A Hunter's Calling#205.src: I knew this was some kind of mistake! I'll get to the bottom of this!
A Hunter's Calling#205.dst: Bir yanlışlık olduğunu biliyordum! Bu işin aslını ortaya çıkaracağım!
A Hunter's Calling#205.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#206.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THERE'S AN ANNOYING WRENCH IN THE WORKS. YOU'VE BEEN DOING YOUR WORK PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#206.dst: İLETİM BAŞLADI: ÇARKLARA SİNİR BOZUCU BİR ÇOMAK SOKULDU. İŞİNİ KUSURSUZ YAPIYORSUN, MEKANİ PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#206.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#207.src: I'VE GOT ONE MORE ORDER FOR YOU THAT SHOULD TIP THINGS OVER THE EDGE. STAND BY FOR TELEPORTATION.
A Hunter's Calling#207.dst: SANA İŞLERİ UÇURUMDAN DEVİRECEK BİR EMRİM DAHA VAR. IŞINLANMA İÇİN BEKLE.
A Hunter's Calling#207.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#209.src: THERE IS A SET OF STATISTICALLY INFERIOR MECHS BUILT BY THE CORKIANS IN THIS TOWER, I HAVE A SET OF SYSTEMS PROGRAMMED IN THIS DEVICE.
A Hunter's Calling#209.dst: BU KULEDE CORKUS HALKININ YAPTIĞI İSTATİSTİKSEL OLARAK DÜŞÜK KALİTELİ BİR GRUP MEKANİ VAR, BU CİHAZA BİR DİZİ SİSTEM PROGRAMLADIM.
A Hunter's Calling#209.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#210.src: THIS WILL OVERRIDE THEIR CURRENT PROGRAMMING AND SEND THEM TO ATTACK THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. THEY'LL BE SO DISGUSTED BY THE CORKIAN'S RELENTLESS BRANDING...
A Hunter's Calling#210.dst: BU, MEVCUT PROGRAMLARINI EZİP ONLARI AVOS YERLEŞİMİNE SALDIRMAYA GÖNDERECEK. CORKUS'UN BİTMEK BİLMEYEN MARKA TAKINTISINDAN O KADAR TİKSİNECEKLER Kİ...
A Hunter's Calling#210.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#211.src: NO, I CAN'T EVEN KEEP UP THE SARCASTIC FACADE ANYMORE. THEY'LL ATTACK AND KILL AVOS PEOPLE AND SET THE CIVIL WAR BLAZING. DO YOUR JOB QUICKLY. END TRANSMISSION.
A Hunter's Calling#211.dst: HAYIR, ALAYCI TAVRI BİLE SÜRDÜREMİYORUM ARTIK. AVOS HALKINA SALDIRIP ÖLDÜRECEKLER VE İÇ SAVAŞI ALEVLENDİRECEKLER. İŞİNİ ÇABUK YAP. İLETİM SONU.
A Hunter's Calling#211.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#214.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: YOUR JOB IS OVER, MECH PL-{~}Y. I HESITATE TO SAY YOU DID A GOOD JOB, BECAUSE THE JOB WAS ANYTHING BUT GOOD. IT WAS NECESSARY THOUGH.
A Hunter's Calling#214.dst: İLETİM BAŞLADI: İŞİN BİTTİ, MEKANİ PL-{~}Y. İYİ İŞ ÇIKARDIN DEMEYE DİLİM VARMIYOR, ÇÜNKÜ İŞ İYİ OLMAKTAN ÇOK UZAKTI. AMA GEREKLİYDİ.
A Hunter's Calling#214.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#215.src: WE WILL BE ABLE TO LET THEM TEAR EACH OTHER TO SHREDS INSTEAD OF GETTING INVOLVED AND SPARKING SUSPICION.
A Hunter's Calling#215.dst: İŞE KARIŞIP ŞÜPHE UYANDIRMAK YERİNE BİRBİRLERİNİ PARAMPARÇA ETMELERİNE İZİN VERECEĞİZ.
A Hunter's Calling#215.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#216.src: I HAD WANTED TO FIND A SOLUTION THAT WOULD NOT REQUIRE A FRESH START. IF MY HAND WAS NOT FORCED, PERHAPS. BUT THAT IS IRRELEVANT NOW.
A Hunter's Calling#216.dst: SIFIRDAN BAŞLAMAYI GEREKTİRMEYEN BİR ÇÖZÜM BULMAK İSTEMİŞTİM. ELİM ZORLANMASAYDI, BELKİ. AMA ARTIK ÖNEMİ YOK.
A Hunter's Calling#216.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#217.src: YOU WILL RETURN TO THE FACTORY WITH THE TELEPORTATION MECH AND REMAIN UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE-
A Hunter's Calling#217.dst: IŞINLANMA MEKANİSİYLE FABRİKAYA DÖNECEK VE YENİ BİR EMRE KADAR ORADA KALACAKSIN-
A Hunter's Calling#217.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#218.src: I knew it! It was such a longshot, but I knew the Factory still had to be at large! And now I have evidence to prove it, too!
A Hunter's Calling#218.dst: Biliyordum! Çok uzak bir ihtimaldi ama Fabrika'nın hâlâ ortalıkta olması gerektiğini biliyordum! Artık bunu kanıtlayacak delilim de var!
A Hunter's Calling#218.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#219.src: This time we'll make sure you won't get another chance. I'll tell everyone what happened, and then we'll tear that factory down at the foundations!
A Hunter's Calling#219.dst: Bu sefer bir şansın daha olmayacağından emin olacağız. Herkese ne olduğunu anlatacağım, sonra da o fabrikayı temelinden yıkacağız!
A Hunter's Calling#219.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#220.src: You should've picked a more private meeting place! I'm out!
A Hunter's Calling#220.dst: Daha gizli bir buluşma yeri seçmeliydin! Ben kaçtım!
A Hunter's Calling#220.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#223.src: Aah, you're fast! You caught up this quick?! I have no other choice...
A Hunter's Calling#223.dst: Aah, hızlısın! Bu kadar çabuk mu yetiştin?! Başka seçeneğim yok...
A Hunter's Calling#223.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#224.src: You aren't going to stop me from getting to the battleground! You look like you were scrounged up from rust and verdigris!
A Hunter's Calling#224.dst: Savaş alanına gitmeme engel olamayacaksın! Pas ve bakır yeşilinden toplanıp yapılmış gibi görünüyorsun!
A Hunter's Calling#224.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#225.src: Surrender, or I'll use my own mechs to smash you to scrap metal!
A Hunter's Calling#225.dst: Teslim ol, yoksa kendi mekanilerimle seni hurdaya çeviririm!
A Hunter's Calling#225.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#226.src: You have defeated both of my most powerful creations...
A Hunter's Calling#226.dst: En güçlü iki yaratımımı da yendin...
A Hunter's Calling#226.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#227.src: I usually don't do this... but I guess I have no other option. I need to get this information to the others.
A Hunter's Calling#227.dst: Normalde bunu yapmam... ama sanırım başka seçeneğim yok. Bu bilgiyi diğerlerine ulaştırmam lazım.
A Hunter's Calling#227.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#228.src: No... I... have to tell them.
A Hunter's Calling#228.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#230.src: ...you harden your heart. There is no end, you think.

A Hunter's Calling#231.src: Wrong. The end is in sight.

A Hunter's Calling#232.src: Your soul. It awakens to something new.

A Hunter's Calling#233.src: Not dark. Not light. Not in-between. But separate.
A Hunter's Calling#233.dst: Karanlık değil. Aydınlık değil. Arada da değil. Ama ayrı.

A Hunter's Calling#234.src: Power. Gain. Risk. New beginnings, from an end.
A Hunter's Calling#234.dst: Güç. Kazanç. Risk. Bir sondan doğan yeni başlangıçlar.

A Hunter's Calling#235.src: So... may we offer you the end?

A Hunter's Calling#236.src: The very center... the place deemed closest to your home. There, in the center of Wynn... You shall find the end.
A Hunter's Calling#236.dst: Tam merkez... yuvana en yakın sayılan yer. Orada, Wynn'in merkezinde... Sonu bulacaksın.

A Hunter's Calling#238.src: Halt! Who goes there? Stop, in the name of the {p} army!
A Hunter's Calling#238.dst: Dur! Kim var orada? {p} ordusu adına, dur!
A Hunter's Calling#238.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#239.src: Should you continue, you shall face the strength and courage of Admiral Aegis!
A Hunter's Calling#239.dst: Devam edersen Amiral Aegis'in gücü ve cesaretiyle karşılaşacaksın!
A Hunter's Calling#239.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#241.src: We cannot back down against any foe! Chaaaarge!!
A Hunter's Calling#241.dst: Hiçbir düşmana karşı geri adım atamayız! Hücuuuum!!
A Hunter's Calling#241.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#243.src: Excuse me, I think you're forgetting someone.

A Hunter's Calling#244.src: {p} will not fall today. We'll be making sure of that!
A Hunter's Calling#244.dst: {p} bugün düşmeyecek. Bundan biz emin olacağız!

A Hunter's Calling#246.src: TASIM! How the hell did you manage to kill him?!
A Hunter's Calling#246.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#248.src: This isn't over! Once your little lackey's dead I'm coming after you!!
A Hunter's Calling#248.dst: Bu iş bitmedi! Şu küçük uşağın gebersin, sıra sana gelecek!!
A Hunter's Calling#248.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#249.src: ...no sense screaming for the dead. But do you think I'm going to just give up like that?
A Hunter's Calling#249.dst: ...ölüler için bağırmanın anlamı yok. Ama öylece pes edeceğimi mi sanıyorsun?
A Hunter's Calling#249.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#250.src: Hah. Didn't know corrupteds had a sense of humor, twisted as it might be.
A Hunter's Calling#250.dst: Hah. Yozlaşmışların mizah anlayışı olduğunu bilmiyordum, ne kadar çarpık olsa da.
A Hunter's Calling#250.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#251.src: I won't dare die while everything here is at stake.
A Hunter's Calling#251.dst: Burada her şey tehlikedeyken ölmeye cesaret edemem.
A Hunter's Calling#251.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#252.src: How's this then, hm? Think your PEON can handle me at my strongest?
A Hunter's Calling#252.dst: Peki buna ne dersin, hm? KÖLEN beni en güçlü halimde kaldırabilir mi sanıyorsun?
A Hunter's Calling#252.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#254.src: And so, you have reached an end.

A Hunter's Calling#255.src: You wonder. It is an end... But to what... purpose. What will you gain?
A Hunter's Calling#255.dst: Merak ediyorsun. Bu bir son... Ama hangi... amaçla. Ne kazanacaksın?

A Hunter's Calling#256.src: You have seen loss. Destruction. Betrayal. All ends, to some other than you. Ends that never came to pass...
A Hunter's Calling#256.dst: Kayıp gördün. Yıkım. İhanet. Hepsi son, senden başkaları için. Hiç gerçekleşmemiş sonlar...

A Hunter's Calling#257.src: To end is a powerful thing. To find your end... You may never stop searching. You may find your end in but a day's time.
A Hunter's Calling#257.dst: Bitirmek güçlü bir şeydir. Kendi sonunu bulmak... Aramayı hiç bırakmayabilirsin. Sonunu bir günde de bulabilirsin.

A Hunter's Calling#258.src: But here... you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.
A Hunter's Calling#258.dst: Ama burada... son getirme gücünü kazanacaksın. Ve kendi sonunun getirilmesini.

A Hunter's Calling#259.src: My armies have been sent to the other cities. Their hero is inevitably busy.
A Hunter's Calling#259.dst: Ordularım diğer şehirlere gönderildi. Kahramanları elbette meşgul.

A Hunter's Calling#260.src: Hm... Ah, hello there! Good to see you around, recruit. Is there anything you needed?
A Hunter's Calling#260.dst: Hm... Ah, merhaba! Seni görmek güzel, acemi. Bir şeye ihtiyacın var mıydı?

A Hunter's Calling#261.src: After the King of {p} ordered the slums cave-in, another war broke out.
A Hunter's Calling#261.dst: {p} Kralı varoşların çökertilmesini emredince yeni bir savaş patlak verdi.

A Hunter's Calling#262.src: Yellow Beacons are pretty common, and they're great if you want to maximize your net loot throughout your run!
A Hunter's Calling#262.dst: Sarı Fenerler oldukça yaygındır, lootrun boyunca toplam ganimetini artırmak istiyorsan harikadırlar!

A Hunter's Calling#264.src: However. Though the change is irrevocable...
A Hunter's Calling#264.dst: Ancak. Değişim geri döndürülemez olsa da...

A Hunter's Calling#265.src: The power to bring an end. It is a choice. And that... Whether you will use that power, we cannot tell you.
A Hunter's Calling#265.dst: Son getirme gücü. Bu bir seçim. Ve o... O gücü kullanıp kullanmayacağını sana söyleyemeyiz.

A Hunter's Calling#266.src: You must deign to take that choice.

A Hunter's Calling#267.src: We may offer you not one more end.

A Hunter's Calling#268.src: You must find your final end yourself. We will remain... And offer others the same. And so...
A Hunter's Calling#268.dst: Nihai sonunu kendin bulmalısın. Biz kalacağız... Ve başkalarına da aynısını sunacağız. Ve böylece...

A Hunter's Calling#270.src: ???: But here...you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.
A Hunter's Calling#270.dst: ???: Ama burada...son getirme gücünü kazanacaksın. Ve kendi sonunun getirilmesini.
